decisions.decision: Mr. Ebersole and Mr. Toale will be the Selectmen representatives on the Charter Review committee; the other committees and Town Moderator will be contacted for recommendations.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: DPW Director reported the Route 13 project was advertised at an approximate cost.
budget_items.quote: at a cost of approximately $1.4 million, was advertised on july 8th.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Finance Director reported total FY17 collections as a share of estimates.
budget_items.quote: the total collections for fy17 were $37,110,671.82 or 101.07% of fy17 estimates through june 30, 2017.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Categories collected above estimate, including Motor Vehicle Excise.
Taxes collected below the levy estimate.
budget_items.quote: under taxes - we received 99.02% or $241,667.06 less than the levy estimate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tax lien revenue received that was not in the estimated tax levy.
State aid exceeded estimate due to charter tuition reimbursement.
budget_items.quote: $50,285.99 more than the state aid estimate due to an increase in our charter tuition reimbursement

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expended or encumbered share of budgeted expenditures as of June 30, 2017.
budget_items.quote: we expended/encumbered $36,811,166.27 (99.49%) of budgeted expenditures as of june 30, 2017.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: State assessments were higher than estimates, largely school choice and charter tuition.
